project.title: Identification of immunoglobulin switch (S) region binding proteins by insertional ChIP (iChIP)
project.projectDescription: We used insertional ChIP (iChIP) based approach to identify proteins that bind to mouse immunoglobulin switch (S) region. To perform iChIP, we inserted an 8X-repeat of the LexA-binding element (LexA-BE) downstream of the Sα region in CH12F3-2A cells, a mouse B-cell line. The DNA-binding domain and dimerization domain of the LexA protein fused with a FLAG tag and a nuclear localization signal (NLS) was expressed in WT (FNLDD-alone) or Sα-engineered (FNLDD-Sα-LexA) CH12F3-2A cells. The resultant cells were subjected to stable isotope labeling with amino acids in cell culture (SILAC), stimulated with CIT (CD40L, IL4, and TGFβ), immunoprecipitated with an anti-FLAG antibody, and subjected to LC-MS/MS analysis. The identities of the deposited data are as follows: F: WT (FNLDD-alone); D: Sα-engineered (FNLDD-Sα-LexA).
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: The mouse cell line was cultured in SILAC heavy(13C6 L-Lysine, 13C6 15N4 L-Arginine) or light(12C6 L-Lysine, 12C6 15N4 L-Arginine) media. The harvested heavy and light media cultured cells were mixed and subjected to immunoprecipitation of the target genome region. The collected proteins were separated by SDS-PAGE for about 1cm and cut into 6 gel pieces after staining CBB. The proteins in each gel piece were digested by typsin, extracted and subjected for LC-MS/MS analysis by using LTQ-Orbitrap-Velos(Thermo Scientific) equipped with nano-LC (Advance) and HTC-PALautosampler(CTC Analytics). Peptide separation was carried out using the C18 reversed phase analytical column (0.1 mm ID x 15 cm, 3 µm resin, L-column Micro; CELI).
project.dataProcessingProtocol: The mass spectrometry raw files were searched by Mascot server(Matrix science) against SwissProt 2015_04 with following parameters: taxonomy limited for Mus musculus, enzyme was Trypsin, fixed modifications was carbamidomethyl(C), variable modifications were Acetyl(N-term), Oxidation(M), Label:13C(6)15N(4)(R), Label: 13C(6)(K), peptide mass tolerance was +/- 10ppm, fragment mass tolerance was +/- 0.8Da, max missed cleavages was 2. SILAC quantification was carried out by Proteome Discoverer(Thermo Scientific) and data was exported in Excel format.
